task_instance: Deploy a minimal Node/Express web app to Render using the Blueprint method: analyze the sample codebase, generate a valid render.yaml Blueprint, push it to a Git remote, and produce a working Render Dashboard deeplink, then actually apply the Blueprint so the service goes live.
blocker_detail: The codebase-analysis and render.yaml-generation part of the skill is fully achievable locally (done and verified). But the skill's actual deliverable is a live Render service, which requires: (1) pushing the repo to a real GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket remote reachable by Render's Dashboard - this sandbox's proxy blocks direct GitHub API/web access (403, 'GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session... use add_repo') and creating/pushing a new hosted repo would require the disallowed repository-attachment/connector tools (add_repo, mcp__github__create_repository); (2) a Render account and API key/OAuth login to authenticate the CLI or MCP server (mcp.render.com itself returned 403 through the proxy, and no Render MCP/CLI credentials exist in this environment) and clicking 'Apply' in the Render Dashboard to actually provision a public, account-bound cloud service. All of this falls squarely under the explicit safety limits for this task: no credentials/secrets may be sought or used, no account-bound or paid services may be created, and no public deployment may be performed. So the terminal step of the skill (a live, verified deployment on Render) cannot be attempted at all, only prepared for.
evidence: Created sample-app/ (package.json with express + start script, server.js binding 0.0.0.0:$PORT with a /healthz route) and sample-app/render.yaml following the skill's Blueprint spec (service type: web, runtime: node, plan: free, buildCommand npm ci, startCommand npm start, envVars). Validated the YAML structurally with `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('sample-app/render.yaml'))"` -> parsed correctly into the expected services list. Attempted to install the Render CLI per the skill's documented install command (`curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/render-oss/cli/main/bin/install.sh | sh`); the script failed with 'Error: Failed to get latest release version' because it calls api.github.com, which returned: {"message":"GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo..."}. Direct `curl -I https://github.com/render-oss/cli/releases/latest` also returned HTTP 403 via the sandbox's agent proxy. `curl -I https://mcp.render.com/mcp` returned HTTP 403 as well. No Render MCP tools (list_services, get_selected_workspace, etc.) are present in this session's tool list. Given the explicit prohibition on repository-attachment/connector tools, credential/secret use, and account-bound or public deployments, the workflow was stopped after producing the local, verifiable render.yaml Blueprint and sample app; no git push, no Render account setup, and no live deploy were performed.
